cases.sentence: Когда враги Иуды и Вениамина услышали, что ___ строят дом Господу, Богу Израиля, 2 они пришли к Зоровавелю и главам семейств и сказали:
cases.explain: «вчерашние пленники» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity were building a temple to Yahweh, the God of Israel;

cases.sentence: Но Зоровавель, Иисус и ___ семейств Израиля ответили:
cases.explain: «остальные главы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: But Zerubbabel, and Jeshua, and the rest of the heads of fathers’ households of Israel, said to them, “You have nothing to do with us in building a house to our God; but we ourselves together will build to Yahweh, the God of Israel, as king Cyrus the king of Persia has commanded us.”

cases.sentence: Письмо было написано ___ и на арамейском языке .
cases.explain: «арамейским шрифтом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: In the days of Artaxerxes, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of his companions, wrote to Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in Syrian, and delivered in the Syrian language.

cases.sentence: Письмо было написано арамейским шрифтом и на ___ .
cases.explain: «арамейском языке» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: In the days of Artaxerxes, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of his companions, wrote to Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in Syrian, and delivered in the Syrian language.

cases.sentence: ___ Рехум и писарь Шимшай написали царю Артаксерксу против Иерусалима такое письмо:
cases.explain: «Царский наместник» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king as follows,

cases.sentence: Да будет известно царю и то, что если этот город будет отстроен и стены его будут укреплены, то ни налог, ни дань, ни пошлина платиться не будут, и ___ сократятся.
cases.explain: «царские доходы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Be it known now to the king that if this city is built and the walls finished, they will not pay tribute, custom, or toll, and in the end it will be hurtful to the kings.

cases.sentence: В Иерусалиме были ___, правившие всей провинцией, что находится за Евфратом, и им платились налоги, дань и пошлины.
cases.explain: «могучие цари» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: There have also been mighty kings over Jerusalem, who have ruled over all the country beyond the River; and tribute, custom, and toll, was paid to them.

cases.sentence: Так работа над ___ в Иерусалиме остановилась и не возобновлялась до второго года правления Дария, царя Персии .
cases.explain: «Божьим домом» — after the preposition «над», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Then work stopped on God’s house which is at Jerusalem. It stopped until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.

cases.sentence: Так работа над Божьим домом в Иерусалиме остановилась и не возобновлялась до ___ правления Дария, царя Персии .
cases.explain: «второго года» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Then work stopped on God’s house which is at Jerusalem. It stopped until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.
